# MADFAM CV (working label) — ai-portfolio-builder

> A job-specific CV and portfolio builder from Innovaciones MADFAM, incubating and pre-launch: one core profile,
> the jobs a person applies to, and a tailored CV, portfolio and presentation per job. One container serves
> three hosts routed by Host: cv.madfam.io (landing, es-MX and en; noindex until the brand is ruled),
> cv-app.madfam.io (app shell; Janua sign-in built, dormant until configured) and cv-api.madfam.io
> (/api/v1/meta and the owner-scoped API, dormant until a database is configured). /health and /ready answer on
> any Host. The old code is preserved at the git tag legacy-2025-09. No live accounts, AI or prices yet.

Boundary: public repository. Operational detail lives in MADFAM's private ops repository under the
repo-boundary contract (docs/REPO_BOUNDARY.md).

## Invariants

- One Enclii project and one Service, both `cv`; container port 3000, Service port 80, every domain `port: 80`.
- The host table is data (apps/web/src/lib/config.ts); exact Host matches; unknown Host is a 404.
- Identity is Janua, money is Dhanam, LLMs only through Selva, deploy is Enclii, analytics self-hosted Plausible only.
- No invented proof, no prices, no secrets in the tree; madfam.io is the only MADFAM domain.
- Every data row is owned by a Janua `sub`; repository functions take ownerSub first; other owners' ids are 404.
- Sign-in and data are dormant (503 not_configured) until their settings exist.
- Public repo CI runs on GitHub-hosted runners; every action is SHA-pinned; Build & Deploy is dispatch-only.
- A fourth host for user pages (public /<slug>, link-shared /l/<token>; working label cv-p.madfam.io) is inert until
  CV_HOST_PAGES names it; per-page indexing is the owner's choice, link pages are never indexed or cached.
- App pages are declared once (apps/web/src/lib/app-routes.ts): /perfil, /empleos, /empleos/:id, /empleos/:id/adaptar,
  /documentos, /documentos/:id, /documentos/:id/vista-previa, /documentos/:id/imprimir, /ajustes (en under /en).

## Code

- `apps/web/`: @cv/web, Next.js 16 App Router; `src/proxy.ts` routes by Host; `src/lib/` holds the pure routing, header, robots and config logic
- `Dockerfile`, `infra/k8s/production/`, `enclii.yaml`, `.github/workflows/build-deploy.yml`: the one image, its kustomize base, the Enclii manifest, the dispatch-only build caller
- `apps/web/src/server/`: Janua token verification, the Drizzle schema and owner-scoped repository, the API handler
- `apps/web/src/server/metrics*.ts`: observability; `/metrics` on the internal port 9090 only (never a public host), route-template labels, JSON request logs without PII
- `apps/web/drizzle/`: committed SQL migrations; `apps/web/test-pg/`: the real-Postgres cross-owner suite
- `janua.client.yaml`: Janua registrations (names only)
- `apps/web/src/components/ui/`, `src/components/app/`, `src/lib/client/`, `src/lib/copy/`: UI primitives, the app frame, the typed data layer, per-surface copy
- `apps/web/e2e/`: Playwright specs over the built server (two owners, local JWKS, throwaway Postgres)
